title: Access-completion primary-source audit
scope: Attribution and exact-claim positioning; not historical-priority certification or external peer review.

sources.title: Sensor network design for maximizing reliability of linear processes
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata; full original article not obtained.
sources.claim_family: Flow observability and reliable sensor layout
sources.assessment: Established precursor; no detailed theorem non-overlap claim.

sources.title: Redundant sensor network design for linear processes
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and metadata only.
sources.assessment: Broad concept predates this work.

sources.title: Cost-optimal design of reliable sensor networks
sources.read_scope: Primary author-hosted full PDF inspected, especially sections 2, 3 and 6. DOI independently verified against the publisher abstract.
sources.assessment: Explicit spanning-tree-chord observability and prior target/precision design; blocks broad novelty claims.

sources.title: A graphical approach to identify sensor locations for link flow inference
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and metadata, plus secondary thesis discussion; full original article unavailable.
sources.assessment: Established cotree-related sensor placement; exact original theorem comparison incomplete.

sources.authors: Xiangdong Xu; Hong K. Lo; Anthony Chen; Enrique Castillo
sources.title: Robust network sensor location for complete link flow observability under uncertainty
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract/metadata; linked full PDF timed out.
sources.assessment: Measurement-error propagation already considered; cannot claim exact objective novelty from abstract alone.

sources.title: An exact algebraic graph-theoretic framework for cost-optimal sensor placement in large-scale flow processes
sources.read_scope: Primary indexed abstract/introduction and author metadata; full publisher/preprint text inaccessible.
sources.assessment: High-priority overlap risk. Obtain full text before priority-sensitive claims.

sources.title: Identifiability and experimental design in perturbation studies
sources.read_scope: Primary full article, especially sections 2.1 and 2.2.
sources.assessment: Known-topology generic linear-response inverse problem; rank/vertex-path/max-flow design is established. Different from exact circulation recovery.

sources.authors: Ignacio A. Martinez; Gili Bisker; Jordan M. Horowitz; Juan M. R. Parrondo
sources.title: Inferring broken detailed balance in the absence of observable currents
sources.read_scope: Primary introduction and informed partial-entropy-production/control discussion. Not a complete audit of later Matters Arising.
sources.assessment: Observed-link control with hidden rates held fixed is an established access assumption.

sources.title: Optimum Allocation in Linear Regression Theory
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and metadata.
sources.assessment: Linear-functional allocation and unequal measurement costs are established; no original broad allocation claim.

sources.title: Computing c-optimal experimental designs using the simplex method of linear programming
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and indexed introduction.
sources.assessment: Finite uncorrelated linear regression objective; distinguish variance from adversarial interval radius.

sources.title: Statistical estimation and optimal recovery
sources.read_scope: Historical metadata and earlier unified audit; no fresh full proof review.
sources.assessment: Attribution background, not evidence for a specific new graph formula.

sources.title: On the minimum s-t cut problem with budget constraints
sources.read_scope: Primary full PDF abstract and introduction, including complexity discussion.
sources.assessment: Two-criterion terminal-cut hardness is established; current nonlinear calibration objective requires its own reduction.

sources.authors: Stefan Kratsch; Shaohua Li; Daniel Marx; Marcin Pilipczuk; Magnus Wahlstrom
sources.title: Multi-budgeted directed cuts
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract and version record; full proofs not audited.
sources.assessment: Known neighboring hardness; not the identical energy objective.

sources.title: Nonequilibrium Response for Markov Jump Processes: Exact Results and Tight Bounds
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract, introduction and setup; HTML conversion incomplete. Closest response attribution also supported by the later Bao-Liang full equations.
sources.assessment: Stationary current-response connection is established.

sources.title: General Theory of Static Response for Markov Jump Processes
sources.read_scope: Primary metadata and abstract; not full theorem audit.
sources.assessment: General foundation, not a source for claiming absence of a transient result.

sources.title: Nonlinear Response Identities and Bounds for Nonequilibrium Steady States
sources.read_scope: Primary full HTML: equations (2b), (3)-(5), Supplement VIII (S82)-(S84), and conclusion.
sources.assessment: Finite stationary barrier response, including parallel channels, already covered. Fixed-time transient endpoint sign is a distinct candidate statement; priority not established.

sources.title: Mutual Linearity in and out of Stationarity for Markov Jump Processes: A Trajectory-Based Approach
sources.read_scope: Primary full HTML: linear response derivation and section V time-dependent kernels/Laplace-domain theorem. Journal issue and DOI independently verified on publisher page.
sources.assessment: Transient response kernels are established; inspected statements differ from the finite-amplitude all-time endpoint-sign result.

sources.authors: Carlos Floyd; Aaron R. Dinner; Suriyanarayanan Vaikuntanathan
sources.title: Local imperfect feedback control in non-equilibrium biophysical systems enabled by thermodynamic constraints
sources.read_scope: Primary full HTML introduction, section III and barrier discussion; not every feedback theorem proof.
sources.assessment: Steady-state response sign fixed across perturbation strengths. Different variable from fixed-pulse transient time; important close attribution.

sources.title: A Universal Control Budget for First-Passage Kinetics
sources.read_scope: Primary version record plus v1 introduction/control-budget results.
sources.assessment: Completion-time sensitivity, not prescribed-time endpoint occupancy.

sources.title: Exact First-Passage Time Response Theory from Steady-State Response
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract, introduction and supplementary sections III-V.
sources.assessment: Maps first-passage responses to auxiliary steady-state response; not the current finite-time endpoint sign theorem.

sources.title: Exact Finite Response of Higher-Order Statistics in Nonequilibrium Networks
sources.read_scope: Primary publisher abstract and metadata only; publication-day and full text not obtained.
sources.assessment: Variance sign-reversal language must not be confused with transient endpoint sign. Full overlap check remains open.

sources.authors: Pauline Coolen-Schrijner; Erik A. van Doorn
sources.title: The deviation matrix of a continuous-time Markov chain
sources.read_scope: Primary publisher abstract and university metadata; full proof review incomplete.
sources.assessment: Established Markov potential theory; historical search of all finite-time positivity identities remains incomplete.

sources.authors: Sarah Dendievel; Sophie Hautphenne; Guy Latouche; Peter Taylor
sources.title: The time-dependent expected reward and deviation matrix of a finite QBD process
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract, metadata and article structure; not full proofs.
sources.assessment: Transient deviation matrices are established objects; do not rename them as new universal operators.

sources.authors: Andrea Smirne; Dario Egloff; Maria Garcia Diaz; Martin B. Plenio; Susana F. Huelga
sources.title: Coherence and non-classicality of quantum Markov processes
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract, main theorem discussion and Appendix C classical Chapman-Kolmogorov comparison; not independent reproof.
sources.assessment: Coherence-generation/detection criterion for multi-time statistics; different access contract from channel-suppression endpoint response.

sources.authors: Kacper Prech; Patrick P. Potts; Gabriel T. Landi
sources.title: Role of Quantum Coherence in Kinetic Uncertainty Relations
sources.read_scope: Primary main-text bounds/classical-model comparison and driven-qubit supplementary example.
sources.claim_family: Quantum violation of classical kinetic bounds
sources.assessment: Current noise/activity witness with explicit classical comparison; analogous theme but not same response inequality.

sources.title: Slow is fast: raising barriers to accelerate thermal relaxation
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract and version metadata only.
sources.assessment: Noncommuting schedules in relaxation already studied; not a prior-art clearance for transient endpoint theorem.

sources.title: Relations among quantum processes: bisimilarity and congruence
sources.read_scope: Primary introduction and equivalence/congruence discussion.
sources.assessment: Bisimilarity failing under parallel composition is established.

sources.title: Open Bisimulation for Quantum Processes
sources.read_scope: Primary introduction and congruence section structure; not all proofs.
sources.assessment: Open bisimulation/congruence is an established response to composition problems.

sources.title: Exact and ordinary lumpability in finite Markov chains
sources.read_scope: Source supplied by composition agent; not independently full-text audited in this pass.
sources.assessment: Established foundation, not claimed original.

sources.title: Three Partition Refinement Algorithms
sources.read_scope: Source supplied by composition agent; not independently full-text audited in this pass.
sources.assessment: Established algorithmic foundation.

sources.title: On the Relationship between Bisimulation and Trace Equivalence in an Approximate Probabilistic Context
sources.read_scope: Composition-agent reference; primary arXiv abstract and author/title metadata independently verified. Not full proofs.
sources.assessment: Existing approximate bisimulation and trace-error foundation.

limitations: The complete historical literature was not exhaustively searchable.
Unavailable papers are recorded as unresolved, never as evidence of novelty.
Several 2026 preprints have not been established here as peer-reviewed journal articles.
No third-party full text is included in this release.
Provenance, simulation reproducibility, empirical validation and historical priority are separate questions.
